blocks.text: The chapter presents wrongdoing through two vivid visions. A flying scroll carries a curse against theft and false swearing that reaches into offenders’ homes. The second vision portrays Wickedness as a woman shut inside an ephah under a lead weight, then carried by winged women to a prepared house in Shinar. The imagery strongly depicts wrongdoing as both exposed and removed, though the precise meaning of its figures and destination remains debated.
